# name-varieties

<!-- Generated by swift-argument-parser -->

A utility exercising every supported argument name variety.

```
name-varieties [-v] [--quiet] [-c=<c>] [-level=<level>] [--format=<format>]
  [--help]
```

**-v:**

*A flag with only a short name.*


**--quiet:**

*A flag with both short and long names.*


**-c=\<c\>:**

*An option with only a short name.*


**-level=\<level\>:**

*An option with only a single-dash long name.*


**--format=\<format\>:**

*An option with only a long name.*


**--help:**

*Show help information.*


## name-varieties.help

Show subcommand help information.

